item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a bar magnet that Sahil cuts into three pieces. Each piece is labelled.

What should he expect about magnetic poles?

options.A: Each piece still has both a north pole and a south pole.
options.B: One piece is a lone north pole with no south pole.
options.C: Only the red-painted end on each piece is a magnetic pole.
options.D: The smallest piece has no poles at all.
